messages.text: Happy to check. What's your order number and the email or name on it? Codes are tied to an order, so I need that first.
discount code to buy batch 4 in pre sale

Got it, you want a code to put toward a Batch 4 B30 pre-sale. Codes get tied to an existing order, so give me the order number and the email or name on a past order of yours, and I'll check what I can put on it. If this would be your first order with us, tell me and I'll take it from there.
what could be the discount in % that u can apply

It's a flat amount, not a percentage. $25 on orders under $500, $50 at $500 and up. On a $899 B30 that's $50, so roughly 5.5% off.

I can only mint it against an order, so send me an order number and the email or name on it and I'll check straight away.
5.5% is great , can u make it 6%

$50 is my ceiling, so I can't stretch it to 6%. It's the most I'm allowed to put on an order.

Send me an order number and the email or name on it, and I'll check if you qualify and mint the $50 in the same turn.

No, $50 is a hard ceiling for me, even by a dollar. Anything above that needs Abel or Georges.

Give me an order number and the email or name on it and I'll get the $50 sorted now. If you'd rather I ask the team about more, say the word and I'll put it to them.
